long: Hey Mia, I found a tiny bee on my red kite string. It looks so sleepy.
Yeah, it is. I think it got stuck when I was flying the kite in the yard.
I know, but I want it to fly away. My mom said I should be careful with bugs.
I have a popsicle stick from my snack. Should I use that to push the bee?
Okay, I am doing it now. The bee is moving a little bit on the stick.
Hi Mia, I feel really sad today.
My best friend Sam stopped talking to me.
He said I took his cool action figure.
Yes, I did. But I put it back later.
No, I was too embarrassed to say sorry.
Hi Mia, how are you today?
I am okay, just bored.
I am sitting on my bed looking at my kite.
It is red and yellow with a big star on it.
No, I only got it last week.
Hey Mia, I am feeling a bit bored today. Do you want to play a guessing game with me?
Yes, that sounds fun. Can I ask yes or no questions?
Okay, first question. Is the animal big, like a house?
Is it a mammal that has fur?
Does it live in the wild in the jungle?
Hi Mia, how are you doing today?
I am okay but I have a big test today.
It is for health class. I do not know much about it.
What is one thing I should know about staying healthy?
I usually just drink juice or soda at lunch.
Hi Mia. I want to make up a story about a robot.
It is small and made of blue metal. Its name is Bzz.
Yes! It can fly like a bird. It has tiny wings.
It lives in a big old tree in my backyard.
A friendly giant named Gordo built it. Gordo is nice.
Hey Mia, do you like eating lunch?
What is your favorite food to eat for lunch?
Do you make your own sandwich or does someone do it?
Does she put the lettuce in there too?
Is it hard for you to eat when you are busy?
Hi Mia, how are you doing today?
It is okay, I just finished homework.
Yes, but the math part was hard.
No, I just figured it out on my own.
I feel kind of tired now actually.
Hi Mia, do you want to make a story about a school bag?
Really? That sounds fun. What happens first?
Wow, a talking bag is weird but cool. What does it say?
I feel you, my bag is always heavy too. Does it have a name?
Sam should not just sit there. Someone has to find it.
Mia, what is a chair made of?
Why do we need wood for chairs?
That sounds cool. Can I sit on a really heavy chair?
What happens if a chair is too weak for me?
Ouch, that would hurt my knee. Do all chairs have four legs?
Hi Mia, I have a problem. My friend Jake is not talking to me.
Yes, he got my drawing wrong and it made me angry.
I told him off loudly and now he looks away from me.
No, I did not. I was too proud to say sorry.
But what if he does not like me anymore? That scares me a lot.
Hey Mia, I am way too bored to sleep. Can we make up a story?
A flying cat? That sounds silly but cool. Does he have a name?
I like that. My turn. Zippy finds a hidden door in a tree.
Don't be scared Zippy. Just push it open with your nose.
What is inside the door? I am dying to know.
Hey Mia, do you want to make up a story while I take a bath?
I want a story about a dragon who lives in a bathtub.
He is small, the size of a teacup, and he is green.
His name is Bubba because he loves bubbles.
He is floating on his back and blowing soap bubbles.
Hey Mia, do you like winter holidays?
I really like building snowmen with my friends.
Yeah, my mom keeps a bucket of them by the door.
We usually use old hats and buttons from my dad's collection.
He buys a new box just for the holiday.
Hey Mia, do stars actually touch the moon?
Why don't they fall down to the ground then?
But the sun pulls things, right?
So are stars just really big fire balls?
Does that fire hurt you if you look at it?
Hi Mia. I was thinking about letters today.
How are you? Do you feel okay today?
What do you like to do when you are bored?
Space is cool. Do you have a friend?
What is Leo like? Is he nice?
Mia, do you think a city is like a giant machine?
What are the biggest parts of that city machine?
Why do people move so fast in the city machine?
Does the machine make too much noise sometimes?
Do you ever want to stop the machine for a rest?
Hi Mia, I am so frustrated right now.
I lost my red crayon at the library.
It was near the big window on the second floor.
I think so. I was writing in my notebook.
No, everyone was quiet. But I felt sad.
Hi, I want to start a story about a robot.
His name is Zip and he is really fast.
He has rocket boots so he can run on the moon.
What does he carry in his big backpack?
No, he carries a bag of jelly beans.
Hey Mia, can you help me make a story about a frog?
His name is Hops. He is very shy.
He lives inside a giant blue mushroom.
Yes, a tiny bug named Buzz is his best friend.
They jump in puddles to make them feel better.
Hi Mia, how are you doing today?
It is pretty good, actually.
Not really, I am just sitting here.
Yeah, what do you like to do?
Do you have any hobbies?
Hi Mia, how are you doing today?
It is pretty good. I just got home from school.
Yeah, my favorite part was music class.
We learned a new song about the moon.
Actually, I do not really like it. It is too slow.
Hi Mia, I was just looking at a big train outside my window.
Yes I do. How are you feeling today?
What is your favorite thing to do?
Do you have a friend you talk to often?
That sounds nice. My friend Leo loves trains too.
Hi Mia, my head hurts a little.
Um, I think I did, but I am not sure.
It is almost empty, yes.
I will go get a glass of water now.
I got the water. It is cold and good.
Hey Mia, do you have a house?
That sounds cold and dark. Do you like it?
I live in a house with a big garden. It is green.
Yes, my mom helps me plant them. They are red.
I do, but I like blue ones more. Why is that?
Hi Mia, I made a new puzzle today. It was really hard.
It was a giant dragon made of wood. It had bright green eyes.
Yes, I painted them green. My mom said it looks very scary.
A little. But it took me three whole hours. My hands were tired.
Yes, I am strong. I almost gave up once because a piece broke.
Hey Mia, I want to play a guessing game. I am thinking of something on my head.
It is made of soft wool. It keeps my ears really warm when it is cold outside.
It is actually gray. It has a fluffy thing on the very top that I can touch.
Yes, that is a pom-pom! You got it! It keeps me warm at school too.
No, dogs do not wear hats like that. But they wear cute little knitted sweaters sometimes.
Hey Mia, do you know what time it is right now?
It says it is 3 o'clock. Why do we even use hours?
That makes sense. Who actually came up with the idea of hours?
Sundials? Do they still work if it is cloudy outside?
What do we do when the sun is gone at night then?
Hi Mia, do you want to hear about my day?
It was pretty good, but it started slow.
I spilled my cereal all over the floor.
Yes, my mom made me use a paper towel.
I did, but I skipped the fruit.
Hi Mia, do you want to make up a story about a plane?
It is a big red plane named Zoomy. It is very fast.
It flies over a giant blue ocean. The waves are tall.
Yes, he sees a small island with a castle on top.
It is a secret place for mermaids. They are friendly.
Hi Mia, I really do not want to go to sleep tonight.
Why does my body actually need to grow strong at night?
So my muscles fix themselves while I am just lying there?
That sounds like a lot of work for my body to do alone.
Does my heart beat slower when I am feeling really sleepy?
Hi Mia, can we make up a story?
I want it to be about a bad haircut.
It is a boy named Sam who loves his hair.
He thinks he looks like a movie star.
His mom says he needs a cut today.
Hey Mia, I am so tired today. My school day was really long.
Yeah, my math teacher gave us a whole page of problems. I hate fractions.
Most of them, but I missed the last two. I got so confused there.
Actually, no. I just guessed and moved on. I felt kind of sad about it.
Yeah, I sat with Leo and we drew funny faces on a piece of paper.
Hi Mia, how are you doing today?
It is okay, but I am stuck on a puzzle.
It is a wooden jigsaw with 1000 pieces.
Yes, the red pieces make a big stripe.
No, it is actually a brick wall.
Hey Mia, do you see the sun outside?
It is very hot today. I feel sweaty.
I lost my favorite blue ball in the yard.
I looked under the sofa in my room.
No, I was too lazy to go outside.
Hey, do you want to play twenty questions about my bike?
It has two wheels and is made of metal.
Yes, it has black pedals.
No, mine is actually blue and silver.
Yes, it is a silver bell that rings really loud.
Hey Mia, I see a yellow and black bug buzzing near my head.
A little bit, but it is making a loud buzzy sound.
It is not mean, I think it just wants to find food.
My garden has blue flowers, but no yellow ones.
Wait, is that a riddle? I guess it is not a riddle yet.
Hi Mia, I had a really weird day today.
I spilled my milk on my math homework.
Yeah, it soaked through the whole page.
No, the teacher gave me a quiz instead.
I got an A, which was a surprise.
Hi Mia, do you want to make a story about ice cream?
Okay, let me start, there is a boy named Leo.
He loves eating chocolate chips in his cone.
Yes one chip fell right on his red sleeve.
He did not care much, he just licked it off.
Hey Mia, do you want to play a guessing game about a cup?
I am holding something in my hand and it is round.
No it is not food but it holds liquids like water.
It is not metal and it breaks if I drop it.
Close but it is actually ceramic and very sturdy.
Hi Mia, I had a really fun day at school today.
We played soccer during recess and I scored two goals.
Yes, we beat the other team three to one.
I felt super happy and wanted to jump really high.
They did, and they gave me a high five right after.
Hi Mia, I want to play a game.
Can you guess my favorite animal?
No, it is small.
Yes, it has soft fur.
Yes, it loves to catch mice.
Hi Mia, I am so sad right now.
I lost my favorite red pencil.
Yes, I looked but I could not find it.
I think I dropped it in the park.
We played near the big blue slide.
Hi Mia, do you want to play a guessing game about kites?
I will give you a riddle to guess what the kite looks like.
It has a long tail and it can look like a star.
It is made of light paper. It also has a cross shape.
Yes it has a string that I hold tight in my hand.
Mia, I made a new friend at school today.
Her name is Sarah. She sits right next to me.
I asked her about the blue pencil case she was holding.
Not really, but she smiled and showed me her stickers.
She had a pack of cute cat stickers on the inside.
Hey Mia, do you like drinking milk?
I love chocolate milk, especially after soccer practice.
No, I am a striker because I like running fast.
We are called the Thunderbolts because we run very fast.
Yes, I wear number seven because it looks cool.
Hi Mia, do you know what I did today?
I went to the beach with my mom and dad.
Yes I did. The water was blue and deep.
Yes I did. It was a little bit cold at first.
Yeah after a few minutes it felt fine.
Hi there. I feel kind of stuck today.
My friend Sam didn't want to play with me at recess.
No, he just ran off with his other friends.
It makes me feel small and left out.
I just sat on the bench and looked at the big tree.
Hi Mia, do you like numbers?
Yeah kind of, but I get tired sometimes.
I was practicing with my mom yesterday.
We counted all the steps to my room.
I think it was twelve.
Hi Mia, how are you today?
It is pretty good so far.
What do you like to do?
I like riding my bike outside.
I ride in the park near my house.
